existing_proofs_preserved: Complete masked backward row formula, both x/dy fp32 conversions, variance and dy*x reductions, reciprocal sqrt, source-ordered product/subtraction and final storage cast are preserved. Public Real IO includes execution/frame at N<=B; sixteen input/gradient floating pairs and pointer-only candidate equivalence are retained.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Full backward row computation is covered with the source order and both masks.
Independent reshapes, conditional dy copy, output allocation, width rejection, device scope, shared x row stride launch and reshape-back are uncomposed.

dtype_review: Input and gradient independently range over fp16,bf16,fp32,fp64; dx inherits x storage. That correctly includes mixed floating pairs. Additional admitted types or exact dtype rejection behavior remain outside the four-type API.
branch_review: N<=B correctly describes the explicit successful path; the N>BLOCK_N RuntimeError is not an instruction to support oversized fused rows. Only dy gets a last-stride contiguous check, and the kernel receives x.stride(0) for X/DY/DX alike. The original wrapper contract needs this exact wiring, not an assumed common logical layout.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper reshapes x using dy width, conditionally copies dy, then supplies only x.stride(0) for all three buffers before reshaping dx back.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The per-row theorem is not a proof of this actual wrapper transformation, size rejection or all-row result; connecting actual layouts is still required.

structural_gaps.finding: Storage has four floating constructors despite unconstrained original x/dy and explicit conversions to fp32.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Other admitted load/cast/store routes or rejection boundaries require structural cases before numerical assumptions can apply.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: At represented profiles, runtime epsilon conversion, reductions, sqrt/division and source-ordered multiply/subtract rounding are numerical items eligible for explicit deferral.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
